With a dazzling run, she seized victory in 
the Takarazuka Kinen. Standing at the 
center of the cheering turf was, of 
course, Marvelous Sunday.

"Spreading the Marvelous through 
racing"... Just as confirmed at the Tenno 
Sho (Spring), the World 
Marvelous-ification Project is proceeding 
smoothly.

Fuji Kiseki listened to the cheers that 
should have already faded. Today's race 
had undoubtedly stirred her heart, which 
had been stranded in a dark, quiet calm.

The Marvelous light connects and grows 
ever brighter. With a sense of 
anticipation in the air, the days of 
preparation for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
began.
